verses.1: And I turn back, and I open my eyes. And behold, a bird flies away.
verses.2: And he said to me, “What do you see?” I replied, “I see a bird with a length of forty amahs, and its width is also forty amahs.”
verses.3: And he said to me, “This is the one who comes forth from all the land. All those who steal are like this person; all those who commit adultery are also like this person.”
verses.4: May the Lord’s army come and destroy her. She came into the house of the thief and the evildoer in my name. I destroyed her inside her house, along with all her furniture and stones.
verses.5: And the angel of God came to me and said, “Take your eyes off him, and see what he is doing.”
verses.6: And he said, “What is that?” And she said, “That’s the direction from which it comes.” And he said, “Those eyes are everywhere in the world.”
verses.7: And behold, a woman was carried away like a bundle of straw. And that was one of the women who sat inside the pit.
verses.8: And he said, “This is the sin of the wicked. He threw her into the depths of the abyss. He also threw the stone of the tomb over her head.”
verses.9: And I opened my eyes and saw that there were two women who flew around, with spirits in their wings. They carried the body between the earth and the sky.
verses.10: And he said to the angel who spoke to me, “These are the things that will happen.”
verses.11: And he said to me, “Let her be placed in a house in the land of Shinear. Let her be there, according to her design.”
